faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to engage in the business of furnishing lodging
               without having first obtained a business license therefore under this article.
(b)
In any instance wherein a vendor is in the business of furnishing lodging at two or
               more separate locations within the city, separate business licenses for each location
               shall be required.
(Code 1981, § 31-120; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002;
Ord. No. 4548, § 2, 5-2-2016
)
